issues.on_page: Transfers from (to) other funds: Street Fund 13,114; Sales Tax Fund (25,114); Total (12,000)
issues.issue: Gross transfers are printed per fund column. Sales Tax sends 25,114: 13,114 goes to Street and 12,000 goes to the Water and Sewer funds (6,000 each, p7). The extraction records only the net Total-column 12,000 as transfers_out and leaves transfers_in null, which hides the 13,114 Street transfer in. Petersburg_FY2024 records the same row gross. Fix: transfers_in 13,114 and transfers_out 25,114 (source_page 5, each with computed 'from fund columns of Transfers from (to) other funds; net (12,000)'). The roll-forward still holds: 257,452 + 466,734 - 376,058 + 13,114 - 25,114 = 336,128. The detail lines (Street +13,114, Sales Tax -25,114) are already gross and correct.

Category and detail_category disagree: detail_category is 'refuse/sanitation charges', and garbage/refuse charges are category 'Utility Charges'. The same label 'Other revenue' is 'other' on the Water Fund line (detail[57]) and on the statement line receipts[13]. Fix: 'Utility Charges' (the Statement of Activities counts Trash's 36,854, which includes this 100, as Charges for Services), or 'other' with detail_category 'miscellaneous revenue' to match the Water line. Either way, the category and detail_category must agree.
